name: 98252 · Granite Falls, WA
findings: ZIP 98252 (Granite Falls) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98252 (Granite Falls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
